steps.title: Agent Privilege gateway
steps.what: Edits to the aggregate or its policy take about 4 minutes to reach the gateway.
steps.why: A client that can hold only a few MCP connections, or an operator who wants one address and one central decision about which tools an agent gets, needs many MCP servers behind a single endpoint.

steps.title: Per-user upstream OAuth
steps.what: When a member is itself OAuth-protected, upstream authorization completes per calling user using the same two-IdP brokering and token refresh as any fronted server.
